import cadquery as cq
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(1.25)
    .extrude(6.0)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .circle(3.25)
    .extrude(1.5)
    .cut(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0, 0, 7.2), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .box(5.4, 0.6, 1.4)
    )
)
show_object(result)
